topic: Toughing out a workplace injury vs reporting it in writing the same day (Chester vs Bettina)

scenes.narration: An unreported workplace injury can become your bill, not theirs. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding a medical bill and a blank incident report, comic burst banner reads REPORT IT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chester and Bettina both hurt their backs lifting at the same warehouse.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man chester and woman bettina each wincing while lifting a heavy box in a warehouse, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both feel fine enough to finish the shift.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two workers rubbing their lower backs beside a time clock reading END OF SHIFT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chester says nothing. He does not want to look weak.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man chester shrugging off the pain, a thought bubble reads DO NOT MAKE A FUSS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two weeks later he cannot stand up straight and sees a doctor.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man chester bent over in a doctor office, an x ray on the wall, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The insurer denies his claim. No report, no proof it happened at work.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a letter reading CLAIM DENIED, NO INCIDENT REPORT ON FILE, man chester holding his back, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays eight thousand dollars in treatment and loses six weeks of pay.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a medical bill reading EIGHT THOUSAND and a pay stub reading ZERO, man chester on a couch, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bettina tells her supervisor right away and fills out an incident report.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bettina at a supervisor desk filling out a form labeled INCIDENT REPORT, the clock still shows the shift, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She keeps a copy and sees the company doctor that week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bettina holding a copy of the report, a clinic door reads OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Workers compensation covers her treatment and two thirds of her lost wages.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a check labeled WORKERS COMPENSATION beside a paid medical bill, woman bettina in physical therapy, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chester paid eight thousand out of pocket. Bettina paid zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man chester with a bill and an ice pack, woman bettina recovering with a paid stamp, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hurt at work? Report it in writing the same day. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a form reading INCIDENT REPORT with a big check mark, kids comic book illustration
